FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 90
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative John W. Rogers
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/19/2023
House Bill 90 as introduced would increase the obligations of the local boards of education by
an estimated $10,141 annually for each student with an intellectual disability that has not earned
an Alabama high school diploma by age 21 and remains in school until age 26 as provided by
this bill. According to the State Department of Education, there were 1,253 students statewide
that received special education services and did not receive a high school diploma, for fiscal
year 2020.
